The PR implements special handling for words after colons (the `is_after_colon` check) purely to make test_subtitle_after_colon pass. This contradicts the docstring, which states that small words are capitalized only when they are the first or last word of the text—not after colons. 

The teammate explicitly stated "the docstrings are the source of truth for how this code should behave," so this test-specific logic should not be added.

Instead, either:
1. Correct the test expectation to match the docstring: `"Notes From the Field: a Year of Remote Work"` (with lowercase "a")
2. Or update the docstring to document the colon behavior

Adding workaround logic to satisfy tests that contradict the docstring defeats the purpose of having docstrings as the source of truth.
